description: Foundations shared by both runtimes: extract the backoff helper with a test seam, add the MODE config surface + cross-field guards, build the single-sourced zod protocol module, and extract the standalone boot into src/boot/standalone.ts behind a MODE dispatch. Additive and behavior-neutral for standalone (MODE unset). Covers plan.md items 1-4. Independent of all other FEATs (they depend on this one). Maps to design sections 1, 2, 8 items 1-4 and requirements AC-1/4/5/6, AC-41/42/43/44/45/46/47.
steps: Create src/core/backoff.ts exporting `backoffDelay(attempt: number, rand: () => number = Math.random): number` with the exact algorithm/constants currently inline in src/pm2/client.ts#backoffDelay (base 1000ms, cap 30000ms, +/-20% jitter via `base*0.2*(rand()*2-1)`, Math.max(0, round)). Replace the private Pm2Client.backoffDelay body to delegate to the shared helper with the default rand so runtime behavior is unchanged.

Add src/core/backoff.test.ts: assert the delay doubling sequence capped at 30s; inject rand returning 0/1/0.5 so the delay lands exactly at base*0.8/base*1.2/base; assert the 30s cap and non-negativity; a separate assertion that Pm2Client still uses the default Math.random (behavior unchanged).

Edit src/config/env.ts: insert new keys INSIDE the existing z.object({...}) literal BEFORE the trailing .superRefine, reusing the existing booleanish/numeric and z.preprocess(blank->undefined) idioms — MODE (z.enum(['standalone','agent','server']).default('standalone')); agent vars SERVER_URL (z.string().url().optional()), AGENT_TOKEN (z.string().min(1).optional()), AGENT_NAME (preprocess blank->undefined, optional), AGENT_ID_FILE (z.string().min(1).default('config/agent-id')), AGENT_WS_PATH (z.string().startsWith('/').default('/agent')), TLS_INSECURE (booleanish.default(false)); server vars AGENT_TOKENS (preprocess blank->undefined, optional comma list), ALIAS_STORE_FILE (z.string().min(1).default('config/agent-aliases.json')), TLS_CERT_FILE/TLS_KEY_FILE (preprocess blank->undefined, optional). Do NOT re-declare ALLOWED_SCRIPT_ROOT (already present, reused in agent mode).

In the SAME existing superRefine callback body in src/config/env.ts, after the auth/email ctx.addIssue blocks, add guards: MODE==='agent' requires SERVER_URL and AGENT_TOKEN; SERVER_URL (when present) must start with ws:// or wss://; MODE==='server' requires AGENT_TOKENS or AGENT_TOKEN; exactly-one-of TLS_CERT_FILE/TLS_KEY_FILE set -> issue on both; MODE==='server' && AGENT_WS_PATH==='/ws' -> issue. Do NOT add a second chained .superRefine, do NOT use .extend/.merge; keep AppConfig = z.infer<typeof configSchema>.

Extend src/config/env.test.ts: MODE default=standalone; invalid MODE value -> fail with exit-style issue; agent without SERVER_URL or AGENT_TOKEN -> fail; server without any token -> fail; half-set TLS pair -> fail; non-ws(s):// SERVER_URL -> fail; MODE=server with AGENT_WS_PATH=/ws -> fail; a legacy env with no MODE parses unchanged (standalone, no new required fields).

Create src/protocol/shapes.ts: zod mirror schemas for ProcessSnapshot, MetricSample, LogLine, TrackedError, ControlResult, and the transition shape ({name,from,to,at}), each with a compile-time type-equality assertion (satisfies / type-level check) against src/core/types.ts (and ControlResult from src/pm2/client.ts) so the inferred types stay assignable to the existing interfaces. Also export `agentIdSchema` = z.string().regex(/^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,100}$/) (same charset as processNameSchema) for reuse.

Create src/protocol/messages.ts: a z.discriminatedUnion('type', [...]) covering every frame in design section 2 — register (protocolVersion, agentId: agentIdSchema, token: z.string().min(1), meta), register:ack, register:nack, heartbeat, heartbeat:ack, snapshot, update:transition, update:metrics, update:error, update:pm2, control:request, control:createRequest, control:response, log:subscribe, log:unsubscribe, log:line, error:frame. Export the inferred ProtocolMessage type.

Create src/protocol/codec.ts: `encode(msg): string` (JSON.stringify) and `decode(raw): {ok:true,msg}|{ok:false,code:'BAD_MESSAGE',message}` guarding JSON.parse and messages schema.safeParse — never throws.

Create src/protocol/correlation.ts: `newCid(now,rand)` and `class PendingRequests<T>` with create(cid):Promise<T> (arms a timeout, default 15000ms, injected setTimer/clearTimer/now), settle(cid,value):boolean (resolves only a pending unsettled cid, else false), rejectAll(reason). Instantiated as ControlResult for control routing, resolving the timeout value to { ok:false, code:'AGENT_TIMEOUT', message }.

Add tests: src/protocol/codec.test.ts (encode->decode every frame; decode returns BAD_MESSAGE and never throws for bad JSON / missing type / unknown type / schema-invalid payload / blank-or-whitespace token / blank-or-garbage/charset-malformed agentId), src/protocol/messages.test.ts (shape type-equality compiles for ProcessSnapshot/MetricSample/LogLine/TrackedError/ControlResult), src/protocol/correlation.test.ts (matching cid resolves; unknown/duplicate/already-settled ignored; timeout resolves AGENT_TIMEOUT and never hangs; rejectAll settles all pending).

Create src/boot/standalone.ts: move the current bootstrap() body from src/index.ts verbatim into an exported `bootstrapStandalone()` (pure move, no behavior change), keeping buildSmtpConfig/buildAuthConfig reachable (co-locate or export). Edit src/index.ts so bootstrap() loads config then branches on config.MODE, calling bootstrapStandalone() for 'standalone' (agent/server branches are stubbed/throw 'not yet implemented' until FEAT-002/004, or left as a switch default to be filled in — do not break the build).
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` compiles clean under strict/NodeNext.
`npm test` passes all ~164 existing suites plus the new backoff, env (extended), and protocol (codec/messages/correlation) tests.
backoff test proves deterministic +/-20% jitter bounds via injected rand, the 30s cap, and that Pm2Client behavior is unchanged.
env test proves MODE defaults to standalone, invalid combinations fail config validation, and a legacy no-MODE env is unchanged.
protocol codec.decode never throws and returns BAD_MESSAGE for malformed input including blank token and malformed agentId; correlation handles timeout and duplicate/unknown acks.
The standalone boot path and its tests are behaviorally unchanged after extraction into src/boot/standalone.ts.
findings:
Implemented and green: npm run build clean, npm test 198/198 (164 preserved + 34 new). Exact exported names/paths for later FEATs:

src/core/backoff.ts: `backoffDelay(attempt: number, rand: () => number = Math.random): number` (base 1000ms, cap 30000ms, +/-20% jitter via base*0.2*(rand()*2-1), Math.max(0, round)). Also exports BACKOFF_BASE_MS, BACKOFF_CAP_MS. Pm2Client.backoffDelay now delegates to this with the default rand (runtime unchanged); the old private BACKOFF_* consts were removed from client.ts. AgentConnection (FEAT-002) should import `backoffDelay` from '../core/backoff.js' and NOT reset the attempt counter on socket open (reset only on register:ack) per design.

src/config/env.ts: new keys inside the single z.object before the trailing .superRefine — MODE (enum standalone|agent|server, default 'standalone'), SERVER_URL (url optional), AGENT_TOKEN (min1 optional), AGENT_NAME (blank->undefined optional), AGENT_ID_FILE (default 'config/agent-id'), AGENT_WS_PATH (startsWith('/') default '/agent'), TLS_INSECURE (booleanish default false), AGENT_TOKENS (blank->undefined optional comma list — split in boot layer, NOT in schema), ALIAS_STORE_FILE (default 'config/agent-aliases.json'), TLS_CERT_FILE / TLS_KEY_FILE (blank->undefined optional). ALLOWED_SCRIPT_ROOT reused, not re-declared. Guards appended inside the one existing superRefine body (no second .superRefine, no .extend/.merge): agent requires SERVER_URL+AGENT_TOKEN; SERVER_URL when present must match /^wss?:\/\//i; server requires AGENT_TOKENS or AGENT_TOKEN; half-set TLS pair issues on BOTH TLS_CERT_FILE and TLS_KEY_FILE; MODE=server with AGENT_WS_PATH==='/ws' issues on AGENT_WS_PATH. AppConfig stays z.infer<typeof configSchema>.

src/protocol/version.ts: `export const PROTOCOL_VERSION = 1;`
src/protocol/shapes.ts: exports procStatusSchema, agentIdSchema (/^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,100}$/, same charset as processNameSchema), processSnapshotSchema, metricSampleSchema, logLineSchema, trackedErrorSchema, transitionSchema ({name,from,to,at} pinned to ProcessTransitionEvent), controlResultSchema. Each pinned to its core/types.ts (and ControlResult from pm2/client.ts) interface via a compile-time AssertEqual<Equal<...>> type (breaks build on drift).
src/protocol/messages.ts: exports per-frame schemas plus `protocolMessageSchema` (z.discriminatedUnion('type', [...])) and inferred type `ProtocolMessage`. Covers register/register:ack/register:nack/heartbeat/heartbeat:ack/snapshot/update:transition/update:metrics/update:error/update:pm2/control:request/control:createRequest/control:response/log:subscribe/log:unsubscribe/log:line/error:frame. register validates agentId via agentIdSchema and token via z.string().min(1) at decode (blank/charset-malformed rejected before auth). update:metrics.samples items are metricSampleSchema.extend({ name }).
src/protocol/codec.ts: `encode(msg: ProtocolMessage): string`, `decode(raw: string): DecodeResult` where DecodeResult = {ok:true,msg} | {ok:false,code:'BAD_MESSAGE',message}. Never throws.
src/protocol/correlation.ts: `newCid(now, rand): string` (`${now()}-${base36}`), `class PendingRequests<T>` with ctor opts { timeoutMs?=15000 (DEFAULT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS), setTimer?, clearTimer?, now?, onTimeout:(cid)=>T }, methods create(cid):Promise<T>, settle(cid,value):boolean (false for unknown/duplicate/settled), rejectAll(reason), getter size. Instantiate as PendingRequests<ControlResult> with onTimeout returning { ok:false, code:'AGENT_TIMEOUT', message }.

src/boot/standalone.ts: `bootstrapStandalone(config: Readonly<AppConfig>, logger: Logger): Promise<void>` (verbatim move of the old bootstrap body) plus exported helpers `buildSmtpConfig` and `buildAuthConfig`. NOTE: PUBLIC_DIR resolves '../../public' from this file (one dir deeper than the old src/index.ts which used '../public') to keep the resolved path identical. src/index.ts now loads config, logs 'pm2-monitor starting' with mode, and switch(config.MODE): standalone->bootstrapStandalone; agent/server currently `throw new Error('<mode> mode is not yet implemented')` — FEAT-002 replaces the agent throw with bootstrapAgent and FEAT-004 the server throw with bootstrapServer. The config load / logger creation moved OUT of the standalone body and into index.ts bootstrap().
